benefitRows.name: Good Food Trail
benefitRows.offer: Exclusive dining privileges: Good Food Trail dining program at premium restaurants across top cities.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Good Food Trail program portal using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your preferred meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 20% savings at participating restaurants. Complete the payment using your HDFC Regalia First credit card to unlock the offer.
